page_title: JUV 3-0 SAS | Juventus v Sassuolo 16/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's it for today, Marco Piccinini has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+3' That didn't go as planned! Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom right corner was too weak to get past Wojciech Szczesny, who easily kept it out.
90+1' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) has a sight of goal and shoots goalwards, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
89' 3 - 0 Fantastic team goal! Federico Chiesa (Juventus) was set free in the area by Manuel Locatelli and fired low past Andrea Consigli. 3:0.
88' Massimiliano Allegri decides to make a substitution. Andrea Cambiaso will be replaced by Alex Sandro (Juventus).
86' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
84' Substitution. Samuele Mulattieri (Sassuolo) replaces Armand Lauriente.
84' Sassuolo take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

84' Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball is out of play. Sassuolo win a corner kick.
83' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) is flagged for offside.
82' The referee signals a substitution. Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) is brought on as a substitute for Dusan Vlahovic.
82' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to substitute Filip Kostic and he is replaced by Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus).
79' Timothy Weah (Juventus) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
77' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Marco Piccinini blows his whistle for a foul.
76' One of the players from Juventus times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
76' A precise short pass from Federico Chiesa releases Timothy Weah (Juventus) in space inside the box, but he smashes a wild shot high over the bar.
75' The players claim that Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Filippo Missori (Sassuolo) comes onto the pitch so that Mattia Viti can be given a rest.
72' Timothy Weah (Juventus) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
70' Alessio Dionisi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Samu Castillejo (Sassuolo) replacing Domenico Berardi.
70' A substitution has been made. Kristian Thorstvedt is replaced by Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo).
67' The linesman signals that Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
67' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
67' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
66' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
65' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.
64' Gian Marco Ferrari (Sassuolo) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
64' A snap shot by Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) from mid-range towards the middle of the goal catches Wojciech Szczesny flat footed, but he somehow recovers and makes a brilliant save.
64' The corner is swung in but Juventus can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

63' Juventus failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. The ball goes behind for a corner. Juventus will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
63' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out of play. Juventus are awarded a corner kick.
62' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Marco Piccinini blows for a foul.
60' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) spurns a big chance! He makes himself some space to meet a cross and from near the penalty spot sends a header well wide of the left post!
60' Mattia Viti (Sassuolo) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
57' Massimiliano Allegri prepares a substitution. Fabio Miretti is replaced by Timothy Weah (Juventus).
57' Substitution. Federico Chiesa (Juventus) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Kenan Yildiz walks off.
55' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
53' That was close by Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post.
53' Marco Piccinini blows his whistle after Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
52' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
51' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo).
48' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
48' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Kenan Yildiz (Juventus). Marco Piccinini saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
46' Gian Marco Ferrari (Sassuolo) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Half-time substitution. Alessio Dionisi decided to make a change. Martin Erlic (Sassuolo) is replaced by Ruan Tressoldi.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' Marco Piccinini blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' A corner kick by Juventus is thwarted by the well prepared Andrea Consigli (Sassuolo).
45+1' A pass into the penalty area from Matheus Henrique (Sassuolo) is intercepted by the defence. The ball goes out for a corner. Sassuolo can continue in their attacking effort.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful volley was directed towards the bottom right corner, but Andrea Consigli was alert and made an astonishing save!
44' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the right post only for Andrea Consigli to dive and make a save.
42' Martin Erlic (Sassuolo) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marco Piccinini had an easy-decision to make. The free kick will be taken by Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus).
41' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) tries to find Marcus Pedersen with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
37' 2 - 0 Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) sets the ball for the free kick and fires in a beautiful strike, which nestles exactly in the top right corner.
36' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) tackles a bit over-zealously and Marco Piccinini blows for a foul. Juventus win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
35' Filip Kostic (Juventus) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
34' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Juventus are awarded a corner kick.
33' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
33' Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo) serves up a nice cross, but Wojciech Szczesny punches the ball away.

32' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
32' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
31' Fabio Miretti (Juventus) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Marco Piccinini saw the whole situation.
30' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) controls a reverse pass deep inside the box and smacks the ball low towards the middle of the goal, but the Wojciech Szczesny anticipates well and smothers the ball.
29' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) trips an opposition player and Marco Piccinini signals a foul.
29' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
29' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Marco Piccinini has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Sassuolo are awarded the free kick.
27' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) is penalised for holding. Marco Piccinini signals a set piece.
26' Flag up against Danilo (Juventus). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
26' The resulting corner from Filip Kostic (Juventus) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

26' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Juventus.
23' A cross into the box from Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo) is cleared.
21' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) sends a cross into the box, but Wojciech Szczesny comes off his line to gather the ball.
21' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Marco Piccinini blows his whistle for a foul.
20' A cross from Danilo (Juventus) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.

15' 1 - 0 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the top left corner of the net.
13' Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat.
12' Filip Kostic (Juventus) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
12' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
10' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Marco Piccinini blows for a foul.
6' The game is interrupted as Danilo (Juventus) is flagged offside.
6' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
5' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Fabio Miretti (Juventus), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

5' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Juventus have been awarded a corner kick.
2' An attempted cross from Filip Kostic (Juventus) is cleared.
1' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Marco Piccinini no option but to blow his whistle.
1' The match has just started.
Sassuolo will kick the game off.
Marco Piccinini is introduced as the referee for today's match.
